notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.0
notes.content:
Hey, people!
I'm very happy to announce our new update.
Without further ado:

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Spanish Localization[/b]: Thanks to Mariana Castro it was possible to localize our game to latin-american spanish. Now you can enjoy our game in one more language! [i]¡Ahora en español, mira![/i]
[*] [b]Choosing audio and subtitles languagues separately[/b]: The game used to assume that audio and language should be in the same language. Now that we also have latin-american spanish it's only natural this choice is configurable by our players.
[*] [b]Choosing quality level[/b]: One of the requisites for us to have full controller support in our game was that it didn't have the standard Unity launch menu. So I just went there and removed it without a second though. After a while some players with less potent machines gave me a heads up and I put the quality level choise in Options.
[*] [b]Stage Start and Stage Clear[/b]: that was our bad. In our hurry to ship the game we forgot this essential beat'em up detail. I hope you like it!
[*] [b]Warpies enter through the left[/b]: another minor detail was missing. Now, the warpies come walking from the left at every stage start. Before that they just dropped from the heavens like they were dead.
[*] [b]Sound effects[/b]:  we put sfx on ZUZ-4's weapons and some enemies' deaths: ninjas, sumo, ninic and barrot.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Dimension Blast sound was too loud[/b]: for some reason it wasn't integrated to our sound mixer.
[*] [b]Pop-up freezes the game when exiting [/b]: it's all good now, no freezes!
[*] [b]Cutscene 7 effect were way too loud [/b]: same mixer integration problem I mentioned above.
[*] [b]Stage 2 jetski was rerendered in the middle of the jetski [/b]: wrong layer, basically.
[*] [b]Él Masculino's death animation was making him get up twice[/b]: silly animation error. It happens!
[*] [b]Scene and Warpies' meshes were deformed in lower qualities[/b]: So Unity usually lowers the amount of bones depending on the quality. So I just made it keep the same amount of bones regardless.
[*] [b]Ninjas' images were always with a red background [/b]: truth be told their uniforms are too small in the images to show, so I changed the background to make it clearer.
[/list]

[h1]Next steps[/h1]
We're working on Mac and Linux build and we want to make the Ninja Captain a playable character. About the builds, I can test on Linux but since I don't have a Mac I'm having problems with testing it. Whoever wants to help us testing on a Mac, please send a message to contact@pampafox.com.

Oh yeah, and if you have problems please let us know!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixing a bug where one player dying wouldn't let the other one press start.
[*] Fixing a bug where one player with game over would appear as "press start" on the next level.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixing a bug where a player could control both jet skis
[*] Instantiating a new jet ski in case Player2 joins late in the game
[*] Not instantiating a new jet ski in case Player2 joins the game while in the race
[*] Fixing the jittery jet ski bug where it'd bounce insanely throughout the whole gameplay if player picked up the jet ski while jumping
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.1 (minor tweaks)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixing a bug where the thrown enemy wouldn't hit other enemies.
[*] By fixing the bug mentioned above, now the "Strike" achievement is achievable!
[*] Fixing a bug where achievements would only appear after shutting down the game.
[*] Making the game pause when a controller is disconnected (inspired by Child of Light's functionality).
[*] Making the game detect your steam language and choosing the best language for you at start (you can still change it on the menu).
[/list]
